citation: MARGO model paper (2021). Environmental Research Letters. https://doi.org/10.1088/1748-9326/ac243e
description: ClimateMARGO is the MARGO research team's Julia model for exploring combinations of emissions mitigation, adaptation, carbon-dioxide removal and solar radiation management. It couples simplified climate response with damage and control costs, then optimises control trajectories. Inputs are climate, economic and policy assumptions; outputs are relative climate outcomes and control strategies. Spatial coverage is globally aggregated, with experiments extending over the next several centuries and user-selected time settings. Free MIT source includes documentation and interactive examples. A limitation is the model's deliberate simplicity: its authors recommend interpreting patterns and relative outcomes, not relying on quantitative estimates. The README also describes a beta interface subject to structural changes. MARGO can support sensitivity studies of climate assumptions used in infrastructure adaptation scenarios. GCAM (model-gcam) provides a related integrated-assessment model. The accompanying Environmental Research Letters paper is cited separately from the software address.
